stem:
The table shows the weights of different types of chickens in pounds.

Weights of Chickens
Chicken  Weight (pounds)
Ancona  6.01
Cornish  8.6
Leghorn  5.699
Bresse  6.195

Caroline wants to list the weights in order from the least number of pounds to the greatest.

Which weight should be third on her list?
